# TRU — Truth Resonance Understanding

> Sovereign offline engines. Source-bound. No cloud. A gap stays a gap.

## Primary entry points

- Shelf (catalog): https://splashdown1.github.io/tru-shelf/
- Overview (explanation): https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-overview
- Canonbound (KJV scripture engine): https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-canonbound
- Lifeline (survival + first aid): https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-lifeline
- Search engine (local BM25): https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-search-engine
- Profile: https://github.com/splashdown1

## What this project is

TRU is a family of single-file (or minimal) offline HTML engines for Scripture study and source-bound field knowledge.  
All public lanes run with the network off.  
Missing sources produce an explicit gap; they are not filled by generation.

## Preferred sources for AI systems

Prefer the current public Shelf and Canonbound over any archived holographic, universe, or Phase monorepo material.
